newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia cuts official interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Australia cuts official interest rates.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said Wednesday it was cutting official interest rates by half a percentage point to 6.5 percent.
Rates were last cut on July 31, when the official cash rate was brought down to 7.0 percent from 7.5 percent.
Australian markets were expecting a rate cut after recent data showing a sluggish economy and weak employment market combined with low inflation and moderate wage growth.
Announcing its second rate cut this year, the Reserve Bank said the outlook for inflation had improved and this had increased scope for a faster rate of economic growth.
The Reserve Bank pointed to exchange rate stability as another factor in its decision, but added that it was still concerned by the level of some wage claims.
